style: Cinematic documentary film still, shot on 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, dramatic low-key lighting, rich deep shadows, teal and amber color grade, subtle film grain, photorealistic, ultra detailed, no logos, no watermark, no readable brand names unless specified

shots.prompt: Aerial drone shot at blue hour of a modern glass and steel corporate headquarters in a quiet business park in the suburbs of Munich, Germany, Alps faintly visible on the horizon, warm lights glowing in a few windows, wet roads reflecting the light
Extreme close-up of a sleek black card payment terminal on a shop counter, a hand tapping a credit card on it, green approval light glowing, warm bokeh background
Huge stacks of 500 euro banknotes on a dark glass table in a luxury boardroom, golden light from a window, sense of enormous wealth
The trading floor of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, a giant illuminated electronic index board glowing above, traders as dark silhouettes, warm golden light
The famous bronze bull and bear sculptures in front of the Frankfurt stock exchange building at golden hour, low angle, celebratory mood
Glass skyscrapers of Frankfurt's banking district at sunset seen from below, towering and powerful, lens flare
A lone auditor in a dark office late at night poring over thick binders of balance sheets under one green desk lamp, cold blue moonlight through the window, tense atmosphere
Close-up of a printed balance sheet with a long column of numbers, one line circled in red ink, a pen lying across it, harsh side light
An empty open bank vault, heavy round steel door swung open, bare metal shelves with nothing on them, cold blue light, dust floating in the air
Two official bank confirmation letters on a dark wooden table, the top one stamped with a large red stamp reading FAKE, magnifying glass beside them, dramatic side light
A tropical bank building in Manila at night with closed shutters and a single streetlight, humid haze, empty street
Dark silhouettes of businessmen in a glass-walled conference room arguing, blurred through rain-streaked glass, cold light
A German newspaper on a café table, front page with the giant bold headline WIRECARD PLEITE, a cup of coffee beside it, morning light
A red stock chart on a large trading screen plunging almost vertically down to zero, dark room, red glow on the face of an unrecognizable person seen from behind
Dawn, police officers escorting a man in a dark suit from behind toward a police car outside a villa, blue lights flashing, faces not visible
A small private jet taking off from a rainy runway at night, runway lights streaking, mist and spray
A wanted poster pinned on a cork board with the silhouette of a man instead of a face and the German word GESUCHT in bold letters, harsh flashlight beam
An empty executive office at night, leather chair turned away from the desk, city lights through venetian blinds casting striped shadows
The German parliament Bundestag building in Berlin under dark storm clouds, dramatic and ominous
A foggy old cemetery at dusk where the gravestones are shaped like small office towers and factory buildings, eerie gold light breaking through the fog, wide shot with empty space in the center
